files.notes: ModelSelectorComponent, ModelSelectorOptions plus every free helper (modelsAreEqual, getModelSearchFields, scoreModelSearch, numericLocaleCompare, the search-field normalisation) and all constants. Chrome now uses the REAL sibling modules: super::menu_panel::{get_menu_list_layout, MenuListLayout, MenuListLayoutOptions, MenuViewportProvider} and super::modal_back::should_treat_as_back (the private stand-ins were deleted), plus key_hint from keybinding_hints. PARTIAL: the MenuPanel/MenuList/MenuRow child tree is not mounted because ModelSelectorComponent keeps no child list yet; updateList/handleInput/updateResponsiveLayout/search state are 1:1.

ToolExecutionComponent with constructor, updateArgs/markExecutionStarted/setArgsComplete/updateResult, getRenderContext, getCallRenderer/getResultRenderer/hasRendererDefinition/getRenderShell/shouldUseIpythonRenderer/isBuiltInEditTool/isStatusAnimating/usesSelfRenderShell/updateDisplay, selectLatestToolExpandHint, createReplayBuiltInToolDefinition, panelHeader/animated frame. The ipython shell now uses the REAL super::ipython_cell::{get_ipython_code_from_args, IPythonCellComponent, IPythonCellContentBlock, IPythonCellState} (the inline mod was deleted); the component is shared via Rc<RefCell<..>> behind a private SharedComponent adapter. ToolExecutionRendererDefinition is mapped (the renderer half of ToolExecutionDefinition); the renderCall/renderResult closures are represented by has_render_call/has_render_result because the extension contract's renderer closure types live in core::extensions::types.

OAuthSelectorComponent, OAuthSelectorOptions, AuthSelectorProvider/AuthSelectorCategory, compareAuthSelectorProviders, the tab bar/filtering/reserved-row/visible-range logic and updateLayout. Now uses the REAL super::menu_panel types instead of the model_selector stand-ins (private stand-ins gone). PARTIAL: MenuPanel/MenuList/MenuRow children are not mounted (same reason as model_selector.rs).

ScopedModelsSelectorComponent, ModelsConfig, ModelsCallbacks and every free helper (isEnabled, toggle, enableAll, clearAll, moveId, getSortedIds). Now implements pi_tui Component (render over the constructor's child list: DynamicBorder, Spacer, title, session-only note, search input, list rows, footer, DynamicBorder) and Focusable (propagates to the search Input) with the private DynamicBorder/Spacer/Text children of menu_panel/pi-tui.

renderDiff, renderRichDiff, renderDiffSeparator, RenderDiffOptions, RichDiffOptions. The npm `diff` dependency is re-implemented privately (LCS over whitespace-attached tokens) because it is not a Rust dependency.

PARTIAL: buildConversationComponents, ConversationComponentsOptions and isCompactAgentMessageNeighbor are ported 1:1 (same branch order, same malformed-message cases, same pendingTools matching, same `[image]` placeholder). It returns ConversationComponentKind values instead of component instances, because the per-message components (AssistantMessageComponent, BashExecutionComponent, InjectedPromptMessageComponent, ...) belong to other slices; isInjectedPromptMessage is a private copy over the serialized shape.

SubagentSummaryLine, SubagentSummaryCounts, classifySubagentSnapshotStatus, countDirectSubagentStatuses, countRosterSubagentStatuses; classifies through the real agent_roster/daemon_session_list/agents_view_state modules.
CollapsibleErrorComponent, CollapsibleErrorOptions, normalizeErrorDetails, shouldCollapseErrorDetails, summarizeErrorDetails; expand/collapse hints from the real keybinding_hints.
CustomMessageComponent (default renderer + optional extension MessageRenderer), now importing the REAL super::expandable_custom_message::{custom_message_label, ExpandableCustomMessageBox}.
UserMessageComponent with the real prompt_highlight::PromptTokenMask and the recognized-slash-command guard.
EarendilAnnouncementComponent (bundled asset image + copy), real super::dynamic_border::DynamicBorder.
